task: Model a flanged mounting bracket with a cylindrical boss and produce its detail drawing in SOLIDWORKS.
description: Build a solid part of a mounting bracket consisting of a large cylindrical boss, an angled tubular branch at 45 degrees and a triangular mounting flange with three fastener holes, working from the reference sheet input.pdf. All dimensions are in millimeters. Then lay out an A3 drawing containing a front view at 1:1, a full section A-A at 1:1 and an isometric view at 1:2, dimensioned with the principal diameters, wall thicknesses and hole positions. Deliver the part and the drawing as native SOLIDWORKS files.

deliverables.description: Detail drawing sheet with front, section and isometric views
Solid part model of the flanged mounting bracket
